notes.title: Army of Tentacles 2022, Spooky Cat Girls?: Changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/093609f034bbf0c064c59ab751c2d65d3de347b5.png[/img]

Doing things isn't easy. 
Video games are hard, as someone once said I forget who, but it's an actual quote. I think it may be from an executive. I dunno.

Being a niche indie company is hard.

Hired a new writer for [b]Spooky Cat Girls?[/b]'s classroom scenes when it became clear that it would not make a reasonable launch date for October. It was either launch directly before the Halloween sale (and this was hoping Valve would accept the final build on the first submission, never something a designer should bet on) or delay it, and we chose to delay it. We feel December also fits in with the theme of the chosen play.

[b]Super Army of Tentacles[/b] has always been my baby, but it's gone through so many changes, due to gameplay as well as personal reasons, that I feel a disconnect with it. Rather than make a tentpole game that I do not want to make, I handed it off to another team member for a 2023 release. This would be the first Army of Tentacles game not helmed by me, which is exciting as I 100% trust my team and think it is time that we all grow in that fashion. We've been alive almost five-point-something years now.

In the place of [b]Super Army of Tentacles[/b], I plan on making a new, full VN-RPG Army of Tentacles game. I feel much more confident about this one, and it will launch at the same time that [b]Super Army 2022[/b] would have. That will be announced soon, maybe with the other 2022 games. Maybe not. Who knows.

Making games is hard.

notes.title: Midsummer gameplay changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/6814e249d8973330b697bf7d3b4a24783e52bff9.jpg[/img]

So, we're putting the finishing touches on Midsummer, and without going into the gory details, a large chunk of the gameplay was vaporized from existence: the weekly slasher competitions. We still have the endgame slasher segment, and we have changed the game's story to put focus on an endgame segment rather than multiple slasher sections. We feel this is important as an announcement because our store page used to have language directly implying multiple sections throughout the game. 

The silver lining here is that we feel that the focus on a singular slasher section rather than multiple improves the general gameplay and story, as well as the "unique aspect" of such a section existing in the story itself. It was either that or delay the game for something that we now feel would have hurt the gameplay rather than added to it.

notes.title: Super Army of Tentacles, progress update + news
notes.notes:
So. 
Dunno if this announcement is really warranted. Just want to let people know what is going on. 

[b]Super Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b] has three main mechanics: skills/attributes, Word Battles, and Armies.

Well, it did. See, I started work on the project when things were.... let's say, different in the USA, and that, in turn, fueled the direction of the thing. We had already wanted to do something new with AoT 1's army mechanic, but do it better than the first game. Do it with all the game dev we had learned over the years since we've started. So I felt that my internal anger was a good fuel for said mechanic. Who doesn't love a good 'throw out the bad guys' story?

While the main story of the game is still 'the humans somehow occupied Monster Land', after recent events, I just don't feel good about a mechanic where you pre-meditatively build up militias to take over areas. We talked about this, and the bottom line is that we feel that even though the Army mechanic would have been solid, it would have taken away from the main gameplay loop of the first two games. Even though there was a final Invasion mechanic in the first game, the way you recruited your army was never the focal point. The focals were the Word Battles. 

At the end of the day, real people make games, and we don't want to be making a game that we feel isn't up to snuff or is pushed in two different directions. This is the last in the trilogy for us. We know more now and want to do it right, as both a stand alone title and a series cap.

This also allows us to put greater focus on the idea of reactivity to your choices in the world's hubs. Which is cool. 

I'm writing this because, even though it wasn't the selling point of the game or even showcased in screenshots or the trailer, it was in the initial store description and there were shots of it in the trailer and on the screenshot gallery. We've already updated the gallery, but will also be updating the trailer shortly. 

This really doesn't affect the already delayed release date of 2022. If anything, it clarifies a release date. If anything, at max what it means is this will release post-summer 2022, but I honestly don't think that's a concern.

notes.title: 2021: schedule changes + 5 YEARS!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/3e4926b98d15ad05dd2eaa3c9837cf7cac5c5b05.png[/img]

Time has flown. It seems like, just yesterday, we were making dating sims based off of the works of William Shakespeare and RPGs out of Lovecraft lore. Old team members left, new team members joined, and we've just generally had a blast making small, weird games for y'all. We're working hard at getting back to more medium-sized RPG/Viz Novel hybrids, and that's sort of what is on the docket to talk about in this news announcement.

Due to reasons that we won't be going into, the main office is going to be moving twice this year. Because of this, as well as other factors revolving around [b]Super Army of Tentacles'[/b] assets, we will be moving it to early 2022. We wanted February 15th, as that is the release date of the first AoT, but alas, that also presumably would fall within the range of the 2022 Lunar New Year Sale (maybe not, as LNY 2022 is Feb. 1st). 

So, rather than release after Halloween 2021, straight in the middle of the Three Sale Gauntlet (Halloween, Thanksgiving, Winter), which would be an extremely uncertain launch window, we're going to delay [b]Super Army of Tentacles[/b] and push up everything else. 

Starting with....
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1312380/Paper_Shakespeare_Very_Naked_Hamlet
This game came to us from one of the newer team members, and in the spirit of trying new things, and because we're huge theater geeks if you couldn't tell, we're doing an adults only Shakespeare VN. We write words that are big and adult. But you have to know Hamlet in order to see them.

New Release Date: [b]Late February - March 2021[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1349170/Furries__Scalies__Bears_OH_MY_2_Return_to_Kale_Bay
Pushed up because Super AoT is no longer a huge concern this year.

notes.title: 2021 release date changes
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/7b1984b13272b203c42ad2527a8c027213b40964.jpg[/img]

[b]Furries & Scalies & Bears OH MY! 2[/b] has been moved so that it is launching either closer to or directly after [b]Super Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim[/b].

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/67c3c6865ee2c45e187970d30a3e13ebefede1f4.jpg[/img]

One half of the reasoning behind this is because we wanted to give it more time to cook, and we had a much clearer vision for the two Furry Shakespeare games that were going to be our post-Army of Tentacles Winter 2021 games.

One of which is [b]To Date or Not to Date Cat Girls? 2[/b]. The other is one that we had been talking about since 2016 and are all very excited about. We just didn't know what it [i]was[/i] until now. We couldn't see it.

As these are games for an investor, we wanted to knock them out as soon and efficiently as possible while still launching good games. It's also that the Furry/Paper Shakespeare series has generally been more profitable than Furries & Scalies, so that's another reason. Had we all the time and money in the world, all three would be coming out before summer 2021, but that workload would eventually hurt Army of Tentacles 2021. Yes, one could bring up the claim that having an investor has affected us, but only in the sense of what products come first (and that honestly is the ideal situation). We're still making what we want to make next year. We still have creative freedom. 

From everyone here at the office to all of you, have a very happy end of the year. Stay safe. Wear a mask. Have lots of Zoom parties with friends and family.

[b]BREAKS CURRENT SAVES.[/b]

[h3]Upgrade/Update news[/h3]
Work has begun on updating the entire codebase to fit in with where things stand now. "Where things stand now" means two things:

1) Where the company stands/how far we've come
2) So that past Army of Tentacles framework/quality matches up with new additions to the franchise

When we started out in 2016, we didn't quite know everything there is about game development. We still don't. We made mistakes, both financial and judgmental. Some big, some small. We know better coding tricks now, and we are more equipped to deal with the makings of a game. I think that anyone that has followed us over the past four and a half years has seen that we've grown as developers. 

We can't promise the Army 1 and Army 3 remasters - of which both would be free patches - this year. We have a bit on our plate, but it is also clearing up rather quickly. 

While we would love to have both patches hit in unison, Army 1 will probably hit first. There will most likely be a paid graphical upgrade DLC for Army 1 that will come sometime after the actual patch. Possibly. It all depends on if it seems worth it or not.

What to expect in both games:

[b]Army of Tentacles 1[/b]
- New resolution (1920x1080)
- Completely reworked code base
- New UI
- New attribute and leveling system
- New shop/quest system
- Completely reworked Army system
- New party skill system
- New Argument system

[b]Super Army of Tentacles 3: The Search for Army of Tentacles 2[/b]
- New map screen
- Completely reworked code base
- New UI
- New attribute and leveling system
- New shop/quest system
- Completely reworked Army system

These will, of course, break any current saves. It is being coded as to save currently popped achievements. Work has already begun on the UI.

Have a nice day/night/timezone.

notes.title: Self-Isolation and Indie Development Update
notes.notes:
You'd think that self-isolation would be great for an indie dev, right?
Forced to be inside?

Well, yes and no. More no than yes. 

Release dates are all sorts of wacky right now. Halloween Times is going to hit its mark, but Rainbow Hollow may slip.  I recently moved to Boston, and as such, have not been able to fully focus on game development. I'm taking a few days for myself until my work computer arrives late this week. Even then, I'm all out of sorts and discombobulated from both being in a new city, and not being able to get my bearings because of COVID-19 and the mess it caused.  Oh, and I feel like I'm getting sick. No, not COVID symptoms, more like weird stomach stuff.

I've got a schedule, but it is pretty tight, and when push comes to shove, it doesn't look good for the experiment known as Rainbow Hollow getting out anytime soon. I'm much more confident of getting Halloween Times out before summer, and even then, it is going to miss April completely for a May launch. Maybe. We'll see. 

In the coming weeks, we'll be putting up a poll and a forum thread about what people liked and disliked about the first two Army of Tentacles games. Take into mind that we would be revamping the quest, inventory, and attribute/stat systems regardless of comments and criticism. 

Stay safe out there.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/854540/Paper_Shakespeare_Loves_Labors_Lost/
A retelling of Love's Labor's Lost, set in the To Date Or Not To Date? corner of the Paper Shakespeare universe. It's stick figures, and by default, I guess it's considered a dating sim? 

[b]Project Wildcats[/b]: Will be the full-fledged Cthulhu dating sim that a lot of you were asking for. No DLC needed to romance Elder Gods here.

Expect it in November/December. We wanted Halloween, but that's not possible for a few reasons.

[b]Hypothetical Winter Game #2/Project Kitt[/b]: Depends on where we are post-summer.  If it's a go for 2018, expect it in November/December.
